newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to trade MasTec options from Feb 21.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to trade MasTec options from Feb 21.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Wednesday it would trade options on MasTec Inc beginning February 21.
It said the options would have initial strike prices of 60, 65 and 70, with position limits of 7,500 contracts. The stock was down 3/4 at 65-7/8 Wednesday afternoon.
Initial expirations have been set for March, April, July and October.
Susquehanna Investment Group has been named the specialist. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
